input.title: slugify() strips any character outside [a-z0-9] after NFKD normalization
input.body:
File: src/util/strings.ts

slugify() strips any character outside [a-z0-9] after NFKD normalization, so non-Latin scripts (Greek, Cyrillic) are removed entirely, leaving only the "report" fallback used by formatExportFilename in exportUtils.ts. It should preserve letters from scripts that NFKD doesn't decompose into combining accents (e.g. allow \p{L}/\p{N} unicode categories) instead of restricting to ASCII a-z0-9, so names like Greek/Bulgarian report titles keep their original letters in exported file names.
